name: C3-3 Diffusion: 20 reverse steps from pure noise
description: 20 reverse steps on an untrained U-Net; output is noise

params.label: Final denoised image x_0 (untrained → just smoothed noise)

data.noteContent:
The reverse half of diffusion, in one graph. GaussianNoise draws x_T, a (1, 3, 16, 16) tensor of standard normal values; DiffusionUNet builds a network whose job is to predict the noise inside a sample; DDPMSampler subtracts a little of that prediction twenty times and hands back x_0 with the same shape.

The U-Net's weights are random, so x_0 is noise as well. Only a trained model makes the last step land on a picture; what this graph shows is the loop, the schedule and the shapes, which are what a production sampler runs.

Compare the two Prints: same shape, different numbers. Raising num_steps makes the loop longer, and widening GaussianNoise to 1,3,64,64 shows how the cost grows with resolution.

擴散模型的反向那一半，整個放在一張圖裡。GaussianNoise 抽出 x_T，一個 (1, 3, 16, 16) 的標準常態張量；DiffusionUNet 建一個負責預測樣本中噪聲的網路；DDPMSampler 把這個預測一點一點減掉，重複二十次，回傳形狀相同的 x_0。

U-Net 的權重是隨機的，所以 x_0 也還是噪聲。只有訓練過的模型才能讓最後一步落在一張圖上；這張圖給的是迴圈、排程和形狀，而這些和實際的取樣器完全一樣。

比較兩個 Print：形狀相同、數值不同。把 num_steps 調大會走得更久，把 GaussianNoise 改成 1,3,64,64 則能感受到成本怎麼隨解析度上升。

num_steps is the speed-against-quality dial: 20 is fast and coarse, image models ship with a few hundred. beta_start and beta_end are the ends of the linear schedule's variance ramp; cosine ignores both and derives its betas from a curve instead.

num_steps 是速度和品質的取捨：20 步又快又粗糙，實際的影像模型通常用好幾百步。beta_start 和 beta_end 是線性排程變異數斜坡的兩端；換成 cosine 就不會用到這兩個值，改由餘弦曲線推出 beta。
